messages:
emily (partnerships): FYI vendor shipment DS-77 arrived but vendor ops reports a firmware variant on 2 racks that fails our deployment smoke tests. This affects marketplace reserved capacity for next-week SI rollouts. https://vendor.example.com/shipments/DS-77

raj (supply-chain): Can we get the manifest mapping to reservations? I want to see which marketplace resvs vs committed Dedicated.

vendor-api-bot: Manifest DS-77 posted: 12 racks total. Note: items 5-6 flagged firmware=FW-2.1b (non-standard). Tracking: https://vendor.example.com/track/DS-77

emily (partnerships): Affected reservation IDs: MKP-9009, MKP-9010, DED-8122, DED-8123

leah (product): DED-8122 is in the SI integration pilot (nina owns). If those racks are incompatible we need to pause the pilot announcement. We were planning a joint marketplace highlight next Tue.

nina (si-integrations): Confirmed, deployment fails during image burn: kernel panics on disk init. We can reflash but vendor needs to provide signed images. That takes ~48h at their factory if they do it.

ben (vendor-ops): We can reflash and sign, but we need written approval to swap inventories between marketplace pool and Dedicated pool. Also our firmware signing queue has a 24-48h lead.

tom (eng-ops): Short-term mitigation: can we substitute the two DED resvs with spare-pool racks with identical specs? ops has 3 spare racks in US-EAST. That will preserve SLA and the SI pilot.

raj (supply-chain): Spare-pool assignment possible but marketplace routing will be impacted. We should throttle marketplace allocations for MKP-9009/9010 and mark them pending until reflashed.

emily (partnerships): Let's prioritize DED resvs and the SI pilot first. Nina, if ops can assign spare racks, can your team absorb the serial swaps without breaking integration test baselines?

nina (si-integrations): Yes, we have an abstraction layer for hardware IDs. We'll run integrated validation once racks are live. Expect ~6-8h for full smoke.

cs-bot: Note: customer DED-8122 notified of capacity contingency on 2026-02-14T15:02Z. Ticket CM-3321 opened.

leah (product): Also flag the joint announcement: postpone until hardware parity confirmed. I don't want to announce a marketplace availability that can't host the SI partner's demo.

ben (vendor-ops): We're expediting signing priority for DS-77 units. If you accept a temporary serial substitution I can sign the reflashed units with expedited priority. Need legal ack for substitution.

emily (partnerships): @alex (legal) not in thread yet. But we have standard substitution clause for emergency swaps. I'll loop legal and attach the contract excerpt.

vendor-api-bot: Vendor update: DS-77 part-release approved. Units 1-4 cleared, units 5-6 held for reflash. ETA reflash completion: 48h.

raj (supply-chain): Plan summary I propose: 1) Assign SPARE-US-EAST-3 -> covers DED-8122/8123 2) Throttle marketplace allocations for MKP-9009/9010 3) Vendor reflashes units 5-6 and returns to marketplace pool 4) Delay joint announcement until reflashed units validated by Nina 5) Ops to log serial swap events for audit.

emily (partnerships): Sounds good. Raj please execute and post ticket IDs. Nina run validation once spares are live and update here. Leah hold the announcement slate. Ben please send daily updates until firmware cleared.

ben (vendor-ops): Ack. Will post status at 2026-02-15T08:00Z and 2026-02-16T08:00Z or on major changes.

tom (eng-ops): Spare assignment done: SPARE-US-EAST-3 -> DED-8122, DED-8123. Routing policy updated to hold MKP-9009 and MKP-9010 until 1745559000.

nina (si-integrations): Received spares, beginning validation. First pass looks good except NIC firmware version mismatch (minor). Running extended tests now, ETA 7h.

cs-bot: Customer CM-3321 updated: temporary hardware substitution applied to DED-8122/8123. Customer confirmed acceptance.

emily (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll create a follow-up doc for the joint announcement timeline and link the reflashed manifest when vendor completes. Marking this thread to track until vendor reports "reflash_complete".

vendor-api-bot: DS-77 update: units 5-6 status=reflash_in_progress.

emily (partnerships): Resolving this slack thread for now; continuing trace in tickets CM-3321 and SUP-7782. Re-open if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
